description_excerpt: Join us as a Senior Local / Regional Product Manager and take ownership of how we bring products to market in your region. You'll adapt global strategies to local realities, drive go-to-market execution, and ensure our portfolio delivers maximum customer impact and business results. What will you do? Develop and execute regional go-to-market strategies that align with local customer needs and competitive landscapes Craft compelling product positioning, messaging, and value propositions tailored to your market Manage pricing strategies to optimize growth, profitability, and market share…
